name: security-headers
title: Security + caching headers (CSP, HSTS)
summary: A Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, nosniff, frame and permission headers, long-lived asset caching, and a CSP violation reporter.
when: Before any real launch, and always when the site handles personal data, accounts or payments.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co wss://*.supabase.co https://vitals.vercel-insights.com; frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com https://player.vimeo.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests; report-uri /api/csp-report

lines: installCspReporter(); // security-headers pack: before the first render

next: Deploy a preview and open the browser console: a CSP violation names the directive to extend.
Embedding a third party (maps, a booking widget, analytics)? Add its origin to the matching directive in vercel.json.
Self-hosting fonts (fonts pack)? Remove fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com from the policy.
